_comment: Editable presentation settings for the prototype app. Nothing here affects the fitted model: the indicator block only names the two quantities the surrogate was trained on and states how the page converts the first of them into the standardized feature. Edit freely and redeploy.
tagline: A functional prototype linking omics-informed within-host dynamics, effective reproduction numbers, interventions, and a missing-data-aware surrogate.
attribution: Created by our team for the Wellcome Leap AMPLIFY proposal.
license: Open source release planned; see the repository for current terms.

indicator.label: Colonisation density
indicator.note: Quantitative culture from a screening swab or stool sample. The page converts it to a z-score, which is the standardized feature the surrogate was trained on.
indicator.feature_note: z = (density − 6.5) / 1.2, capped at ±3. In the training data this feature is standard normal, so 0 is an average carrier.

organism_note: Which of the two calibrated antibiotic-resistant organisms the individual is carrying.

scenarios.label: ESBL-producing E. coli
scenarios.note: Stands in for the lower-transmission organism, calibrated to a population R₀ near 1.5.

scenarios.label: Carbapenem-resistant K. pneumoniae
scenarios.note: Stands in for the higher-transmission organism, calibrated to a population R₀ near 3.0.
